THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0: And now the dead have come to haunt me?
I have no time for this.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1: The ire of the dead... A foolish idea.
Leave me be and move on, spirit.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2:
Spirits can't truly die, I suppose.
Do you even want anything?
DARV.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-0.ancien:
Well, I'm shocked! A ghost! Have ya' come to haunt me?
I've done no wrong, I swear!
DARV.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-2.ancien:
Ah, I get it, ya want one of these!
Well, go grab whatever catches your fancy!
DARV.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1-0r.ancie:
Back to the ol' haunting grounds, spooky one? 
Maybe one of these will help those poltergeisty desires?
DARV.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-0.ancien:
Found some real spooky stuff for ya this time, spooky one.
See this carving?
DARV.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-2.ancien:
Maybe... this one's better in your hands!
Don't want to get cursed myself!
You should definitely take it!
NEOW.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1-0r.ancie: [sine]...bound one... time to... turn up the [jitter][red]heat[/red][/jitter]...[/sine]
NEOW.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-2.ancien: [sine]...complete your task... seal will be broken...[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-1.a: Do ones such as you even have need for my fineries?
NONUPEIPE.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-2.a: And yet... a certain [sine]brightness[/sine] is about you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-3.a:
And you haven't even said hello to your host, visitor...
Very well.
Bright and dazzling gifts for the bright and dazzling spirit.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-0.a: You're a curious case, aren't you?
NONUPEIPE.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-2.a:
Still no words for me, spirit?
Clearly no desire for the finer things in the world for the dead.
And yet, you still need my gifts to reach the top.
OROBAS.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-0.anci: Purple shape so warm! And green lights so bright!! Friends??
OROBAS.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1-0r.anc: Bright light shape returns! Shiny for shape friend!!
OROBAS.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-0.anci: Shape back! Why shape so bright always?? And floating??
PAEL.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-0.ancien: [thinky_dots]A restless spirit wanders into these halls...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1-0r.ancie: [thinky_dots]No rest for the spirit... I feel sorrow for your torment...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-2.ancien: [thinky_dots]...a true pity... may you one day find rest...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-0.ancien: A GHOST!? DOES THE GHOST WANT TO BE SCARY?? REALLY SCARY?
TANX.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-2.ancien: GHOST CAN BE EVEN MORE SCARY WITH A WEAPON!
TANX.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1-0r.ancie: TAKE A WEAPON, GHOST!!! GHOST CAN'T DIE AGAIN WITH WEAPONS!
TEZCATARA.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-0.a: A [sine]blessed[/sine] one has come to visit me?
TEZCATARA.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.0-2.a: You know not of the [jitter][b]gifts[/b][/jitter] you possess. [jitter][b]Let me show you[/b][/jitter].
I shall feed your [jitter][b]fire[/b][/jitter] for as long as it takes, blessed one.
TEZCATARA.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-0.a: Do you even know of what you've been gifted? You shouldn't be [jitter][b]disrespectful[/b][/jitter].
TEZCATARA.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-2.a:
That council had no idea what could ~really~ be done with that tablet they created.
And the one they dealt it to is a fool who could not see its full potential.
TEZCATARA.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-3.a: Foolish. But I can clearly see what a soul that burns bright can do with it.
VAKUU.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.1-0r.anci: You deserve this suffering, cursed one.
VAKUU.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-0.ancie:
Sign yourself to me and I will break your seal, cursed one.
The magic is trivial to break for one such as I. [sine]A simple task for a simple signature.[/sine]
VAKUU.talk.HEXAGHOST-HEXAGHOST.2-2.ancie:
You will lose hope eventually. [sine]Everyone does.[/sine]
And when you do... I will be there.
